description: I have to admit it: District 8's Congressional race is utterly fascinating... to me, at least.Just think about it:The two candidates are both women.Therefore: There are no sex or gender differences between them.The two candidates are both Caucasian, meaning "white".Therefore: Race is not an issue.The two candidates are members of the same generation.Therefore: Age-related experience is not a factor, and they've both lived through the same historical events.Both candidates are native-born America

title: Similarities and Differences
